requirements.title: Single snapshot frontier
requirements.statement: ChangeBridge MUST bind each migration generation to exactly one immutable source snapshot frontier S.
requirements.rationale: CDC coverage cannot be proven when the snapshot boundary is implicit or mutable.
requirements.verification_method: contract tests plus integration evidence that binds source snapshot metadata to one generation
requirements.failure_condition: A generation has no frontier, more than one frontier, or a frontier that can change after snapshot sealing.
requirements.limitations: The SQLite oracle stores a snapshot LSN; no managed source snapshot is yet bound.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 2 preserves the obligation without choosing the managed capture mechanism.

requirements.title: Half-open CDC coverage
requirements.statement: ChangeBridge MUST define generation coverage as the snapshot at S followed by CDC events in the half-open interval (S, F].
requirements.rationale: An explicit interval prevents duplicate application at S and omissions after S.
requirements.verification_method: boundary model and integration tests for first and last included source positions
requirements.failure_condition: The first CDC event overlaps S, a source position after S is omitted, or an event beyond F is included in proof at F.
requirements.limitations: Local integer LSNs model the interval; DMS checkpoint semantics remain unverified.
requirements.review_notes: The boundary contract must remain transport-neutral.

requirements.title: Frontier lineage
requirements.statement: ChangeBridge MUST retain source identity, engine/version, snapshot checkpoint, terminal frontier F, and generation identity in the proof lineage.
requirements.rationale: A frontier without source and generation lineage cannot prove completeness.
requirements.verification_method: managed evidence schema validation and exact-run reconciliation
requirements.failure_condition: The proof cannot uniquely identify the source, generation, S, F, or producing run.
requirements.limitations: No managed frontier lineage exists on current main.
requirements.review_notes: Static design metadata cannot satisfy this requirement.

requirements.title: Complete normalized event envelope
requirements.statement: Each normalized CDC event MUST preserve source position, transaction identity, order, operation, primary key, before image, after image, schema version, and deterministic replay identity.
requirements.rationale: Loss of source semantics makes correct ordering, conflict detection, delete handling, and replay impossible.
requirements.verification_method: versioned schema validation plus round-trip and property tests
requirements.failure_condition: Any required source semantic is absent, ambiguous, lossy, or excluded from replay identity.
requirements.limitations: The v1 envelope and local reference validator are complete, but the existing runtime model and managed transport do not yet emit the envelope.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 4 supplies contract-level LOCAL_VERIFIED proof while runtime conformance remains Part 2 work.

requirements.title: Contiguous batch chain
requirements.statement: Applied CDC batches MUST form a contiguous chain from the stored generation frontier to the declared batch end frontier.
requirements.rationale: A successful transport can still omit or overlap source intervals.
requirements.verification_method: state-model tests for contiguous, gap, overlap, duplicate, and restart paths
requirements.failure_condition: A batch starts anywhere other than the committed frontier or advances to a non-increasing end frontier.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied only for the local SQLite oracle, not managed transport.
requirements.review_notes: Managed proof remains separately required by CB-OPS-003.

requirements.title: Deterministic transaction order
requirements.statement: Transactions and events MUST be applied in a deterministic order consistent with committed source order.
requirements.rationale: Non-deterministic order changes target state for conflicting mutations.
requirements.verification_method: ordering oracle, permutation property tests, and managed transaction-order evidence
requirements.failure_condition: Equivalent immutable inputs can produce different event order or target state.
requirements.limitations: Typed position and tie semantics are locally verified, but the current apply engine still consumes integer LSN batches and no managed adapter conformance exists.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 4 settles the total-order contract without changing runtime adapter behavior.

requirements.title: Transaction boundary preservation
requirements.statement: ChangeBridge MUST preserve source transaction boundaries through normalized ingestion and target application.
requirements.rationale: Partial transaction application violates source semantics and invalidates checkpoint safety.
requirements.verification_method: multi-event transaction tests and failure injection at each apply boundary
requirements.failure_condition: A subset of a committed source transaction becomes visible or checkpointed.
requirements.limitations: The local oracle groups events but managed DMS-to-Iceberg transaction preservation is unverified.
requirements.review_notes: Transport chunking must not redefine a source transaction.

requirements.title: Insert correctness
requirements.statement: A valid insert event MUST create exactly the intended keyed target state once.
requirements.rationale: Duplicate or missing inserts corrupt migration completeness.
requirements.verification_method: model, property, integration, and managed target tests
requirements.failure_condition: A valid insert is missing, duplicated, or creates a value different from the normalized after image.
requirements.limitations: Local SQLite behavior exists; Iceberg mutation does not.
requirements.review_notes: Managed verification is still required.

requirements.title: Update correctness
requirements.statement: A valid update event MUST transform exactly the keyed target row to the normalized after image while retaining auditable source lineage.
requirements.rationale: An update implemented as an uncontrolled overwrite can hide conflicts or lose lineage.
requirements.verification_method: before/after, conflict, replay, and managed Iceberg tests
requirements.failure_condition: The wrong key or value is mutated, a conflict is silently overwritten, or lineage is lost.
requirements.limitations: The local oracle does not validate an event before image against current target state.
requirements.review_notes: Conflict policy must be explicit in the Stage 4 contract.

requirements.title: Delete and tombstone correctness
requirements.statement: A valid delete MUST remove the keyed row from active state and retain an auditable tombstone with source position.
requirements.rationale: Silently dropped deletes are a common CDC correctness failure.
requirements.verification_method: delete, replay, compaction, and managed table tests
requirements.failure_condition: A deleted row remains active, an unrelated row is removed, or the delete cannot be audited to its source position.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied only in the local oracle; Iceberg delete/compaction behavior is unimplemented.
requirements.review_notes: Tombstone retention policy remains a later operational decision.

requirements.title: Idempotent identical replay
requirements.statement: Replaying an identical immutable batch or transaction MUST be a deterministic no-op.
requirements.rationale: At-least-once delivery and restart require safe replay.
requirements.verification_method: repeat application and state/digest equality tests
requirements.failure_condition: An identical replay changes data, frontier, ledger, or output classification.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied only in the local reference engine.
requirements.review_notes: Managed replay proof remains mandatory.

requirements.title: Conflicting replay rejection
requirements.statement: Reusing a batch or transaction identity with different canonical content MUST fail closed before publication.
requirements.rationale: Identity reuse with changed content makes replay non-deterministic.
requirements.verification_method: digest-conflict tests at batch and transaction grain
requirements.failure_condition: Conflicting content is accepted, ignored, or partially applied under an existing identity.
requirements.limitations: Local oracle only; distributed writer conflict behavior remains unproven.
requirements.review_notes: Canonical digest inputs must be versioned.

requirements.title: Target commit and checkpoint coupling
requirements.statement: The source checkpoint MUST advance only in the same success decision as the durable target commit and transaction ledger.
requirements.rationale: Advancing a checkpoint after partial apply permanently loses source changes.
requirements.verification_method: state-machine oracle and failure injection before, during, and after target commit
requirements.failure_condition: Any failed or indeterminate target application can advance the restart checkpoint.
requirements.limitations: SQLite transaction coupling exists locally; Iceberg/checkpoint coupling is not designed or implemented.
requirements.review_notes: Detailed architecture is a Stage 3 blocking decision.

requirements.title: Failure leaves committed state unchanged
requirements.statement: A failed batch MUST leave target state, transaction ledger, batch ledger, and generation frontier at the previous committed state.
requirements.rationale: Partial failure must not create an unprovable migration state.
requirements.verification_method: injected failure and before/after state equality
requirements.failure_condition: A failed batch changes any committed data or advancement record.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied for one SQLite transaction only; no distributed target proof exists.
requirements.review_notes: Managed proof must inject failures at real commit boundaries.

requirements.title: Deterministic restart
requirements.statement: After interruption, ChangeBridge MUST restart from the last mutually committed target/checkpoint state and produce the same result as uninterrupted execution.
requirements.rationale: Recovery cannot rely on operator guesswork or a transport-only offset.
requirements.verification_method: restart at every commit boundary with final-state and evidence equality
requirements.failure_condition: Restart skips, duplicates, reorders, or changes the final state or proof set.
requirements.limitations: No explicit restart API or restart suite exists.
requirements.review_notes: A single replay test is not sufficient.

requirements.title: Versioned schema identity
requirements.statement: Every snapshot and CDC event MUST bind to a versioned source contract and canonical schema digest.
requirements.rationale: Compatibility cannot be evaluated without knowing the exact source contract.
requirements.verification_method: contract validation and schema-digest round trips
requirements.failure_condition: A record is accepted without an exact contract identity or schema digest.
requirements.limitations: Contract identity and digest binding are locally verified for v1 fixtures; runtime producers and managed schema registries are not yet proven conformant.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 4 makes evolution rules explicit and retains PARTIAL until runtime conformance is implemented.

requirements.title: Compatible evolution acceptance
requirements.statement: A schema change classified as compatible MUST be applied deterministically without corrupting existing data or replay identity.
requirements.rationale: Safe evolution is necessary during long migrations.
requirements.verification_method: compatibility matrix and data/replay tests across contract versions
requirements.failure_condition: A compatible change is applied differently across retries or damages prior rows.
requirements.limitations: Only nullable field addition is locally demonstrated.
requirements.review_notes: Type widening and default semantics remain future cases.

requirements.title: Incompatible evolution quarantine
requirements.statement: An incompatible or unknown schema change MUST quarantine the affected generation before target mutation or publication.
requirements.rationale: Fail-open schema drift can silently corrupt target meaning.
requirements.verification_method: negative compatibility fixtures and quarantine state tests
requirements.failure_condition: An incompatible or unclassified schema reaches candidate data or publication.
requirements.limitations: The current checker reports incompatibility but no generation quarantine state exists.
requirements.review_notes: Blocking the cutover alone is insufficient if target mutation already occurred.

requirements.title: Immutable generation isolation
requirements.statement: Each migration attempt MUST write to a distinct generation whose candidate state is isolated from the active generation.
requirements.rationale: Partial candidates must never leak into consumer-visible state.
requirements.verification_method: multi-generation state-model and integration tests
requirements.failure_condition: Candidate writes alter active-generation data or share mutable state with another attempt.
requirements.limitations: SQLite keys data by generation; physical Iceberg namespace isolation is unimplemented.
requirements.review_notes: Storage layout is a Stage 3 design decision.

requirements.title: Backfill and replay isolation
requirements.statement: Backfill and replay operations MUST use isolated generation or run identities and MUST NOT mutate the active generation in place.
requirements.rationale: Operational repair must not race with or corrupt consumer-visible state.
requirements.verification_method: concurrent active/replay model tests and publication rejection tests
requirements.failure_condition: A backfill or replay can mutate, replace, or advance the active generation directly.
requirements.limitations: No explicit backfill or replay subsystem exists.
requirements.review_notes: A command-line convention alone is not isolation.

requirements.title: Frozen-frontier reconciliation
requirements.statement: Source and candidate reconciliation MUST compare data representing the same frozen frontier F.
requirements.rationale: Counts or digests from different logical times are not comparable.
requirements.verification_method: frontier binding tests and managed source/target proof
requirements.failure_condition: Source and target proofs use different frontiers or omit frontier lineage.
requirements.limitations: The local function accepts a frontier parameter but does not acquire frozen source data.
requirements.review_notes: The proof acquisition protocol is a Stage 3 decision.

requirements.title: Hierarchical deterministic proof
requirements.statement: Reconciliation MUST produce deterministic machine-readable totals, partitions, and localized key-range or bucket proofs.
requirements.rationale: A full-table digest detects mismatch but is not scalable or operationally localizable.
requirements.verification_method: determinism, partition coverage, mismatch localization, and bounded-scale tests
requirements.failure_condition: The same immutable inputs yield different proof, partitions omit rows, or mismatch cannot be localized below full-table scope.
requirements.limitations: Current reconciliation uses counts and full-table canonical digests only.
requirements.review_notes: Scale claims require later measured evidence.

requirements.title: Mismatch blocks publication
requirements.statement: Any unresolved reconciliation mismatch MUST block readiness and publication.
requirements.rationale: Cutting over a known mismatch defeats the migration correctness objective.
requirements.verification_method: known mismatch injection and cutover rejection
requirements.failure_condition: A generation with a failed or missing reconciliation proof can become ready or active.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied only for the local gate object.
requirements.review_notes: Managed orchestration is not implemented.

requirements.title: Proof before publication
requirements.statement: A candidate generation MUST become publishable only after every required schema, reconciliation, lag, pre-migration, rollback, and evidence gate passes.
requirements.rationale: Publication is the consumer-visible correctness boundary.
requirements.verification_method: truth-table oracle for all gate combinations plus integration tests
requirements.failure_condition: Any failed, missing, stale, or unbound mandatory gate permits publication.
requirements.limitations: The complete eight-gate truth table and manifest semantics are locally verified; runtime orchestration and managed publication remain unimplemented.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 4 fixes the exact gate set and retains PARTIAL because local specification proof is not runtime proof.

requirements.title: Single publisher compare-and-swap
requirements.statement: Consumer-visible generation publication MUST use a single versioned compare-and-swap decision.
requirements.rationale: A single atomic pointer prevents mixed-generation consumer reads without claiming cross-table transactions.
requirements.verification_method: pointer-version state-model and concurrent writer tests
requirements.failure_condition: Publication requires multiple independently visible pointer mutations or can lose a concurrent update.
requirements.limitations: Satisfied only in the SQLite oracle; no DynamoDB managed proof exists.
requirements.review_notes: This does not assert atomic writes across Iceberg tables.

requirements.title: Stale writer rejection
requirements.statement: A publisher using a stale expected pointer version MUST be rejected without changing the active generation.
requirements.rationale: Stale writers otherwise overwrite a newer cutover or rollback decision.
requirements.verification_method: concurrent stale-version state-model tests
requirements.failure_condition: A stale expected version changes the active pointer or reports success.
requirements.limitations: Local SQLite proof only.
requirements.review_notes: Managed conditional-write proof remains required.

requirements.title: Explicit rollback safety
requirements.statement: Rollback MUST be an explicit, authorized compare-and-swap transition to a retained, readable, previously proven generation.
requirements.rationale: Rollback must not reverse-mutate partially migrated tables or select an unproven target.
requirements.verification_method: explicit rollback API tests, retained-generation readability, stale-writer rejection, and managed exercise
requirements.failure_condition: Rollback can target an unproven/unreadable generation, mutate data in reverse, or bypass pointer concurrency control.
requirements.limitations: The generic local activation primitive exists, but no rollback API or executable rollback scenario exists.
requirements.review_notes: Documentation alone does not satisfy rollback correctness.

requirements.title: Fail-closed lag gate
requirements.statement: Cutover MUST be blocked when CDC lag is missing, stale, or above the approved threshold.
requirements.rationale: Excessive or unknown lag creates an incomplete target at cutover.
requirements.verification_method: boundary tests for absent, stale, equal, and above-threshold lag plus managed metric lineage
requirements.failure_condition: Cutover is allowed with unknown, stale, or excessive lag.
requirements.limitations: Local numeric gate exists; no CloudWatch or DMS lag lineage exists.
requirements.review_notes: Threshold provenance must be recorded in managed runs.

requirements.title: Operational observability and runbooks
requirements.statement: Every critical migration state, gate failure, recovery action, cutover, and rollback MUST be observable and linked to an executable runbook.
requirements.rationale: Correctness controls that operators cannot observe or act on are incomplete.
requirements.verification_method: alarm inventory, failure drill, runbook execution record, and evidence link checks
requirements.failure_condition: A critical state or failure lacks a signal, owner, response, or run-bound evidence link.
requirements.limitations: A design runbook and partial CloudWatch declarations exist; no executed runbook evidence exists.
requirements.review_notes: Alert existence is not proof that response works.

requirements.title: Managed migration proof
requirements.statement: At least one managed AWS run MUST prove happy path, injected failure, recovery, restart, deterministic replay, cutover, and rollback at an exact commit.
requirements.rationale: Local models and static infrastructure cannot prove managed integration behavior.
requirements.verification_method: bounded managed run with immutable inputs, injected failures, raw logs, proof artifacts, and teardown
requirements.failure_condition: No exact-commit managed run covers every required lifecycle path with recoverable evidence.
requirements.limitations: No managed migration run exists.
requirements.review_notes: OIDC identity and Terraform validation do not contribute runtime proof.

requirements.title: Bounded performance and cost measurement
requirements.statement: Performance, lag, recovery, throughput, and cost claims MUST come from immutable bounded workloads with raw observations and exact run lineage.
requirements.rationale: Unbounded or unattributed numbers are not defensible measurements.
requirements.verification_method: repeatable workload execution, raw metric capture, calculation audit, and bounded comparison
requirements.failure_condition: A numeric operational claim lacks workload, environment, raw data, method, bound, or exact run identity.
requirements.limitations: No performance or cost measurement exists.
requirements.review_notes: Modeled values must use EXTRAPOLATED, not MEASURED.

requirements.title: Least privilege and protected data
requirements.statement: Managed ChangeBridge resources MUST use least-privilege identities, encryption, bounded network access, and no committed credentials.
requirements.rationale: Migration correctness does not excuse unsafe data or credential handling.
requirements.verification_method: static policy tests, deployment inspection, secret scan, and access-denial probes
requirements.failure_condition: A resource is unencrypted, unnecessarily exposed, over-privileged, or requires committed credentials.
requirements.limitations: Terraform is partial and has no deployed-state security proof.
requirements.review_notes: Static declarations alone are DESIGN_ONLY.

requirements.title: Teardown and residual-state verification
requirements.statement: Every bounded managed run MUST execute an approved teardown and verify expected retained evidence and absence of unintended billable resources.
requirements.rationale: A portfolio lab must control cost and leave a provable final state.
requirements.verification_method: destroy plan/apply evidence and independent residual inventory
requirements.failure_condition: Run resources remain unintentionally active or teardown evidence cannot be reconciled to the deployment inventory.
requirements.limitations: No managed resources are created in Part 1.
requirements.review_notes: Retained evidence must be intentional and non-billable or cost-bounded.

requirements.title: Exact repository and run binding
requirements.statement: Every proof artifact MUST bind repository, stage, exact commit/tree, command or procedure, inputs, result, digest, evidence label, limitations, and run identity when applicable.
requirements.rationale: Unbound evidence cannot prove the code or environment being claimed.
requirements.verification_method: schema and referential validation plus exact Git/GitHub comparisons
requirements.failure_condition: A proof cannot be traced to the exact repository state, procedure, result, and limitation it supports.
requirements.limitations: The self-referential final commit and merge identities require external post-publication checkpoints.
requirements.review_notes: Stage 2 implements registry validation; later stages must produce their own bound evidence.

requirements.title: Claim-to-proof compatibility
requirements.statement: Every material public claim MUST use an allowed evidence label whose minimum proof is satisfied by named references.
requirements.rationale: Documentation must never outrun implementation or evidence.
requirements.verification_method: claim registry, public-surface fingerprinting, and fail-closed validator
requirements.failure_condition: A public claim is missing, stronger than its registry wording, or uses an incompatible proof class.
requirements.limitations: Satisfaction is limited to current registered repository claim surfaces.
requirements.review_notes: New public surfaces must enter the registry before merge.

requirements.title: Deterministic evidence generation
requirements.statement: Canonical evidence generated from unchanged inputs MUST be byte-identical across clean executions.
requirements.rationale: Volatile evidence obscures semantic changes and weakens review.
requirements.verification_method: two clean executions with byte and SHA-256 comparison
requirements.failure_condition: Unchanged canonical inputs produce different bytes or digests.
requirements.limitations: Volatile GitHub run metadata is intentionally external to canonical payloads.
requirements.review_notes: Sorting output is necessary but not sufficient; input discovery must also be stable.

requirements.title: Fail-closed authority validation
requirements.statement: Malformed, unknown, stale, unsafe, unregistered, cross-project, or proof-incompatible authority records MUST fail validation.
requirements.rationale: Permissive parsing converts missing proof into apparent success.
requirements.verification_method: positive fixtures plus one-fault negative fixtures asserting exact diagnostics
requirements.failure_condition: Any designed invalid case passes or fails for an incidental diagnostic instead of its intended rule.
requirements.limitations: The validator proves repository authority structure, not runtime CDC behavior.
requirements.review_notes: Unknown semantic fields are rejected.

requirements.title: Final release mutual binding
requirements.statement: Final main, required CI, annotated tag, released assets, checksums, and PROJECT_COMPLETION_VERIFIED MUST mutually identify one immutable release state.
requirements.rationale: A release assembled from different commits or runs cannot be independently verified.
requirements.verification_method: release graph and checksum validation from an independent checkout
requirements.failure_condition: Any final binding references a different commit, run, tag, asset, checksum, or completion decision.
requirements.limitations: Stage 2 defines the obligation and does not create a release or tag.
requirements.review_notes: No checklist percentage can substitute for this binding.

requirements.title: Senior-level explainability
requirements.statement: The project owner MUST be able to explain each major design choice, invariant, failure path, evidence boundary, tradeoff, and limitation by pointing to repository authority.
requirements.rationale: A portfolio project is not defensible if its owner cannot trace claims to implementation and proof.
requirements.verification_method: timed interview rehearsal with repository navigation and adversarial follow-ups
requirements.failure_condition: A major claim, limitation, or failure response depends on chat memory or cannot be located and defended from the repository.
requirements.limitations: Part 1 creates the repository walkthrough; the human rehearsal remains mandatory at final ChangeBridge project completion.
requirements.review_notes: The walkthrough must include negative findings, not only the happy path.
